qualificationScope.meaning: Known actual browser/element/action/connection and typed CDP compatibility failure producers only. Arbitrary website results, exception substrings, unrelated prose and unreviewed dynamic fields remain unknown. Codes describe a cause family, never no-effect authority.
qualificationScope.effectAuthority: All normalized compatibility failures remain effect_uncertain, inspect_before_retry, reuseAllowed=false. Existing opaque exact-original owner proof is required for no-effect settlement; no message classification replaces it.

transparentWrappers.meaning: Only source-defined transparent workflow wrappers expose a nested known owner message. Unknown wrappers and arbitrary exception contents are never searched for substrings.

legacy_selector_observation.rationale: Selectors and snapshot refs bind a particular observed page/frame; a missing/ambiguous/stale target requires current observation rather than repeating input.
legacy_selector_observation.evidenceRequirement: Exact original task/request and owner outcome, current process/target/mode and fresh permitted observation. The error pattern is cause provenance only, not current evidence, permission or physical-effect proof.

remediation.instruction: Read a new snapshot of the SAME currently owned CDP task and select an actual unique current element/ref, including the intended frame. Native-only tasks use their supported native_capture instead of forcing CDP. Check the exact original operation outcome before choosing new explicit input; do not guess selectors, click peer tabs, bypass policy or treat a changed DOM as no-effect proof.
remediation.precondition: Use only existing authority for the exact original task/profile and current mode. Retain original request/outcome; uncertain input must never be replayed or declared no-effect from this message.

legacy_selector_observation.resumeCondition: Current original owner/target and permitted observation support the explicitly selected continuation; the original request remains failed/uncertain unless separately settled by actual owner evidence, and it is never silently replayed.
